channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 31 Aug 2026
SAT: Research-Creation Residency Program in Arts and Technologies 2026-28 (Montreal)
item.description: Societe des arts technologiques (SAT) · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CAD 10,000 grant per selected project, for individual artists and collectives alike. Also included: access to SAT workspaces during the residency periods, access to equipment and software resources subject to availability, mentoring and training activities (on site and remote), creative and technical support from the SAT teams, and documentation and archiving of the work. Travel, meals and accommodation beyond the grant are NOT covered. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.
